long_name: Constant Altitude Plan Position Indicator at 2000 m (CAPPI2)
description: Special values: -9999 is the _FillValue (decoded to NaN by xarray) and marks pixels outside the radar network coverage or missing time steps. Pixels inside the coverage with no echo above the network sensitivity threshold are encoded as -9998 (from 2026-04-30T23:05 onward, and in parts of 2025) or as 0 dBZ (older data), following changes in the DPC processing chain. Neither no-echo value is masked by xarray; -9998 is safe to treat as 'no echo', while 0 dBZ is ambiguous with a genuine weak echo.
